text: Visiting their father's grave in rural Pennsylvania, Barbra and her brother Johnny are attacked by [a pale man in a tattered suit|threat|the dead that rise]. Barbra flees to a farmhouse where a stranger, Ben, boards up the windows against a growing horde, while a family and a young couple hide in the cellar with a little girl [bitten on the arm and seriously ill|rules|it passes to others]. [Radio and television bulletins|images|pictures, screens and recordings] report the dead rising across the East Coast, and [the people trapped inside turn on each other|threat|people in your own life] as the night wears on.
